collector_context.headline: Believability read: no current finding
collector_context.finding: No current finding is published for Believability read because the source status is degraded.
collector_context.method_summary: the Li Keqiang composite (40% loan growth, 40% electricity, 20% rail freight, using the canonical weights) against the state's own headline industrial-production YoY for the same month. The statistic is DRIFT: this month's headline-minus-composite gap against the gap's own rolling median and MAD band, so a services-heavy economy's persistent gap reads as baseline and only a break in the established relationship registers. Electricity is PRODUCTION (the keyless state series), not the original's consumption; this is a stated substitution. A missing component abstains the composite rather than reweighting it; fewer than 8 months of history publishes the gap but claims no drift (warming_up). Full method, origin, critiques and counterpoint: docs/BELIEVABILITY.md. A reading outside the band is evidence the relationship moved; it does not, by itself, establish fabrication

collector_context.headline: The official yuan fix gap is -0.6632% against the independent reference
collector_context.finding: The current official-fix minus independent-reference gap is -0.6632%.
collector_context.method_summary: two prices for one currency: the state's 09:15 Beijing fix vs an independent same-day market reference (ECB concertation, 14:15 CET = 20:15 Beijing). gap_pct > 0 means the market prices the yuan weaker than the fix; the band is ±2%, so gap_pct is read against that scale. Computed only on days a fix exists — ECB prints CNY on Chinese holidays and a gap against an unset fix would be fiction. Onshore only: no licence-clean keyless CNH source exists (the TMA fixing is licensed), stated rather than worked around. cross_check_diff is the ECB-vs-BoC derivation disagreement, published so a silent break in either source is visible; it is null on rounds where the Bank of Canada leg did not answer. Economic backdrop, not censorship — deliberately off the alarm board
